topic: Myth-bust: the viral 'a local model read its own weights' claim, measured against what the weight-reading test actually did
title: A model read raw weights. Not its own.
description: Your feed said a local model read its own weights. The test: a twenty-seven-billion-parameter model on a laptop was handed the raw weights of a toy network with seventeen thousand two hundred fifty-three parameters, and it named the game that toy plays, three of four times, in forty-six minutes and twelve seconds. Real weight reading, yes. Reading itself, no. Try it tonight: ollama run qwen3.8:27b, give it a long context, and use the prompt from RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs.

hook_candidates: Your laptop model can read another network's mind.
Seventeen thousand numbers. It named the game.
Forty-six minutes. Your laptop read a neural net.
Seventeen gigabytes. It reads weights, not words.
Qwen 3.8 read raw weights and guessed the game.
Three of four games. From numbers alone.
You downloaded a model. It reads other minds.
Seventeen thousand weights in. Pac-Man out.
Your model file can read its own kind.
No calculator. It still named the game.
narration_full: Your feed said Qwen read its own weights. It named a game from seventeen thousand numbers. Those seventeen thousand two hundred fifty-three parameters are a toy network, built for the test. Not the model's own twenty-seven billion parameters. Given that toy's raw weights, it named three of four games right. The full run took forty-six minutes and twelve seconds. It guessed Pac-Man on the obscure one, and the trace is almost incomprehensible. Weight reading is real: it answered questions about numbers handed to it, the toy's raw weights. It never once looked inward. Your laptop can read real weights tonight. The prompts are waiting in RikiyaT's repo.

notes_for_review: Myth-bust shape: hook states the measurement number at second 0, the breaker (17,253-parameter toy, not its own 27 billion) completes by about second 7, truth-instead in s04, and the 'myth is still right' beat is the payoff itself (real weights, on a laptop). Four key numbers spent: 17,253 parameters, 27 billion, 3 of 4, 46m 12s; the spoken command tag echoes the 27B figure rather than adding a new number. One new number per sentence, every sentence at or under 20 words, no positional labels, no em dashes. s04 is the single scene without a number or named entity (the allowed one). Known advisory: hook first sentence is 3 words against the 5-12 advisory band; it is the assigned mandatory hook, kept verbatim. The command tag 'qwen3.8:27b' is spoken as words per voice rule 4 and shown exactly on screen; renderer should keep the terminal line at 64 px so it fits without a continuation. Analogy is null on purpose: none of the signature vehicles fit weight-reading, so the plain mechanism (numbers handed in, no inward path) carries s04.
